summary: This note describes a music video concept for the Level 42 song "Something About You". Mark King appears as a dark clown magician who represents the negative aspects in the relationships of Mike Lindup, Phil and Boon Gould with their girlfriends. All the girlfriends are played by actress Cherie Lunghi.
one_line: Describes the video concept for Level 42's song "Something About You", with Mark King as a dark clown magician.
